'''Sørvágs Ítróttarfelag''', commonly known as '''SÍ''', is a sports association based in [[Sørvágur]], [[Faroe Islands]]. It was founded on 17 March 1905.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sis.fo/index.asp?pID={59EA2A30-F495-4D33-A94D-0F3D940C0FA8}|publisher=Sørvágs Ítróttarfelag|title=Søga felagsins|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120717070441/http://www.sis.fo/index.asp?pID={59EA2A30-F495-4D33-A94D-0F3D940C0FA8}|archivedate=17 July 2012|accessdate=8 March 2019|language=Faroese}}</ref>
[[Image:Sorvagur, faroe islands, football field.jpg|200px|thumb|View of the football pitch in [[Sørvágur]].]]"}}
